card.title: Nintendo Switch PCB Reverse Side overview

source.title: Nintendo Switch Mainboard Reverse Side Overview

claims.statement: The reverse side of the PCB includes a Maxim MAX77621 DC/DC converter, a Realtek ALC5639 audio codec, and a Pericom PI3USB30532 USB 3.0/DP1.2 3:2 matrix switch.
claims.evidence: Text description and board photo showing PCB Reverse Side

claims.statement: Storage board can feature either Samsung KLMBG2JENB 32 GB eMMC or Toshiba THGBMHG8C2LBAIL 32 GB eMMC NAND Flash IC.

card.caveats: Image is a top-down photographic overview showing component layout, not a schematic, voltage map, or diode reading chart.
